template_data.headline_html: Five pricing mistakes that quietly cost you before the first sale.

items.title: Wrong commercial baseline
items.sub: Basis of Award ties your GSA rate to your best commercial discount — know that link before you submit.

items.title: Price Reductions Clause gap
items.sub: Discount a commercial client later and you may owe GSA that same rate retroactively.

items.title: Pricing to get on, not sustain
items.sub: A low rate wins approval. A rate that doesn't cover delivery costs eventually breaks the contract.

items.title: No price realism check
items.sub: Contracting officers notice desperation pricing — rates too low raise capability questions, not competitive ones.

items.title: Stale annual price list
items.sub: Market rates shift. GSA prices that don't move leave you overpriced or priced out of winnable bids.
